# Phones Farm Box (https://www.phonesfarmbox.com)

> Real-device phone farm box hardware supplier and knowledge platform — Guangzhou, China since 2017. Quote-based B2B export: chassis, USB hubs, PSU, cooling, network gear, setup services. Not cloud phone SaaS.

## Brand
- Name: Phones Farm Box
- Domain: https://www.phonesfarmbox.com
- Location: Guangzhou, China
- Language: English (primary)
- Model: Written BOM quote before payment; MOQ from 1 unit

## What we sell
Phone farm boxes, motherboard rack boxes, Android and iPhone phone farms, empty chassis, USB hub servers, power supply modules, cooling kits, network routers, custom cabinets, remote batch-control setup services.
